title: Seen release compatibility manifest
description: Exact canonical input consumed by the Seen compiler and version-coupled package client; omitted or mismatched values are never inferred or repaired.
$comment: The components.compiler.package_interface_schema entry binds reusable source-package compatibility; seen-package-interface-v2 includes the independently versioned native seen-package-layout-v1 contract. The components.compiler.object_cache_abi identity seen-object-cache-abi-v3 binds seen-import-graph-v1 canonical module ordering, the seen-global-initialization-plan-v1 dependency-first constructor schedule, the seen-production-ir-policy-v1 unmodified optimizer handoff, the seen-production-source-policy-v1 unmodified compiler-input handoff, the seen-machine-diagnostic-v1 stable diagnostic envelope, seen-build-instrumentation-evidence-v1, seen-release-optimization-plan-v1, seen-test-discovery-v1, seen-test-run-v1, seen-test-assertion-v1, seen-test-snapshot-v1, seen-test-fixture-v1, seen-test-report-v1, seen-test-migration-v1, seen-error-v1, seen-typed-error-v1, seen-error-api-migration-v1, seen-error-policy-v1, seen-owned-resource-v1, seen-secret-marker-v1, and seen-test-instrumentation-v1.
